goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: The revised feature is safe as one coordinated vertical slice once activation identity, threshold latching, M behavior, context-menu suppression, cancellation, and mandatory feedback are explicit. Left Control owns start-anywhere click-versus-marquee arbitration before object drag; Space, middle-button pan, and genuine handles retain precedence. M remains a region-only alternative without exact-toggle semantics. Every selection keeps a minimal filter-independent violet halo, while the existing preference controls emphasis rather than visibility. Per-object overlays, a sidebar-independent live count badge, Layers parity, strict v2 preferences, and primary-only handles avoid misleading collective transforms.

worker_package.objective: Implement the complete revised selection slice: physical ControlLeft start-anywhere click-versus-marquee arbitration; Shift-additivity; scoped macOS context-menu suppression; deterministic cancellation; bounded Left Control/M preference migration; filter-independent per-object violet feedback; primary-only blue handles; an accessible selection-count badge outside both sidebars; all-selected Layers expansion; updated guidance; and behavioral regressions proving selection-only actions remain clean.
verify: npm run test -- --run tests/client-ux.test.ts tests/editor-interactions.test.ts tests/editor-serialization.test.ts tests/selection-preferences.test.ts
stop_if: Any required implementation file is outside allowed_files.
Physical ControlLeft and ControlRight cannot be distinguished using KeyboardEvent.code at the existing capture boundary.
Correct arbitration requires modifying svg.js or dependency code.
Control click-versus-drag cannot be latched at the existing 4 CSS-pixel threshold without allowing object mutation.
Space-primary pan, middle-button pan, ordinary unmodified object drag, resize, rotation, wheel zoom, Alt-click, or double-click no longer reaches its existing owner.
Ordinary right-click, ControlRight-click, transform-handle context menus, or context menus outside the stage can be suppressed.
Key release, Escape, blur, hidden visibility, editable or modal focus, pointercancel, or lost capture can leave activation, pointer capture, overlay, hover, cursor, or changed selection state behind.
Filtered selected objects cannot receive independent feedback without altering authored filter attributes or CSS.
Feedback serializes into SVG, enters Layers or hit testing, changes dirty comparison, creates history, or implies a collective transform.
Preference migration requires changing workspace or session-restoration schemas.
Existing unrelated dirty hunks cannot be preserved without semantic conflict.
The same verification failure remains unexplained after two attempts.
acceptance_checks: ControlLeft plus primary pointerdown freezes the deepest exact candidate, Shift state, scope, origin, and activation identity.
Movement below 4 CSS pixels completes as a Control exact toggle over artwork; at or above 4 pixels irreversibly becomes marquee even if the pointer later returns inside the threshold.
A below-threshold Control gesture on empty canvas clears without Shift and preserves with Shift; all terminal paths suppress the successor click.
Control marquee begins over ordinary artwork, the noninteractive selection bounding shape, SVG-root pixels, artboard, or stage padding, but not over genuine resize or rotation handles.
No object movement occurs during an accepted Control gesture.
Every selected object receives a noninteractive violet halo, including the primary and filtered objects; only the primary receives the blue selection box and handles.
The count badge, Layers rows, dirty state, history, and clean serialization remain synchronized.

evidence.rule: Measure Euclidean movement from pointerdown in client CSS pixels. Less than 4 pixels is a click result. The first movement at or above 4 pixels permanently latches marquee for that pointer sequence; returning toward the origin cannot turn it back into a click.

Capture accepted ControlLeft primary presses at the stage before editor exact-toggle and svg.js drag handlers. Space plus primary and middle-button pan have first precedence. Genuine resize and rotation handles pass through. ControlLeft then owns every other canvas target, including ordinary artwork, empty canvas, and the blue noninteractive bounding shape. Unarmed object presses retain ordinary drag.

Freeze the deepest exact selectable candidate at pointerdown; the blue bounding shape resolves to the current primary. Below threshold, toggle that candidate using the established exact-selection scope rules. Shift does not change object-toggle semantics. With no candidate, frozen Shift preserves selection and no Shift clears it. Suppress the successor click in every case.

At threshold, clear salmon hover and select visible leaf-most matches in the frozen scope. Frozen Shift unions and normalizes the complete prior-plus-new selection; no Shift replaces it. Ancestors and descendants never coexist. Locked visible objects remain eligible and hidden objects remain excluded.

Only KeyboardEvent.code ControlLeft arms left-control activation. ControlRight never arms, even though ctrlKey is true. Shift is allowed; Meta and Alt are not. Repeats are idempotent and cannot create a second activation. Editable, contenteditable, composing, and open-modal contexts cannot arm.

Prevent contextmenu only when it is causally associated with an active or just-completed accepted ControlLeft primary canvas gesture. Use a one-shot bounded token matched by stage containment, Control state, target or coordinates, and time. Consume or expire it. Never suppress ordinary right-click, ControlRight, genuine handles, or events outside the stage.

ControlLeft keyup before pointerup, Escape, blur, hidden visibility, editable or modal focus, pointercancel, lost capture, review lock, or document replacement cancels without toggling or selecting, restores the frozen scope and selection, suppresses successor click/contextmenu, releases capture, removes overlay/hover/cursor state, and disarms until a fresh physical keydown. Escape while merely armed disarms without clearing; a later unarmed Escape retains ordinary clear behavior.

M is a region-only activation alternative, not an exact-selection modifier. When configured, fresh physical KeyM with optional Shift may start the same non-handle start-anywhere marquee. Below threshold it is a selection-preserving no-op over artwork or empty canvas and suppresses the successor click. It never toggles, clears, or moves an object. At threshold it uses the same replace or Shift-add marquee rules and cancellation lifecycle. Legacy refers to the activation key, not empty-canvas-only behavior.

Selection visibility is non-negotiable. Rename the visible control to describe emphasis, such as Enhanced selection outlines. On and off both retain a crisp minimum violet halo around every selected object; on increases halo emphasis without adding handles or a union box. Preserve the bounded boolean during migration.

Render one editor-only, pointer-events-none, aria-hidden violet halo per selected object in a dedicated overlay group using root-space geometry and non-scaling stroke. Never write, replace, or depend on the selected object's filter attribute or computed CSS filter. Refresh halos after selection and interactive geometry synchronization; keep primary blue handles above them.

Strip the halo group and descendants from snapshots and clean SVG, exclude them from selection candidates and Layers, and keep them outside dirty/history state. No union bounding box, numbering, shared handles, or collective movement is permitted. Secondary objects never receive handles; any retained primary manipulation affects only the primary.

Place the multi-selection badge outside both collapsible sidebars. Hide it for zero or one selection; otherwise expose exactly N objects selected with role=status, aria-live=polite, and aria-atomic=true. Announce only count changes. Keep it visible and high-contrast with both sidebars collapsed and respect reduced-motion settings.

Before one Layers render, expand the ancestry of every selected object. If the active filter would hide any selected row, clear and visibly synchronize the query. Mark every selected row aria-pressed=true, retain stronger primary styling, secondary styling for all others, and scroll only the primary into view.

Add regionActivation with left-control or m and default left-control in a strict version-2 global record. Read v2 first. Only when v2 is absent may a valid exact-key v1 record migrate its four values and add left-control. Malformed, partial, extra-key, or future v2 data falls atomically to defaults and must not resurrect v1. Changing activation while armed or active cancels and requires a fresh matching keydown.
